acceptance: A cycle cannot ship a changed function below 100% statement coverage: the ship path (or the build handoff floor) runs the same cover-changed check CI runs, against the same base, in enforce
A test proves a cycle whose diff adds an uncovered branch is refused before it lands, with the refused function named
After rollout, CI on console PRs no longer reports cover-changed refusals for functions that only main changed
fix: Run cover changed on the cycle's diff in the build floor or the ship gate (the build floor already has a shadow cover-changed WARN: promote it to enforce with a recovery rung), using the coverage the floor already collects.
summary: Loop cycles 1869/1870 (be9bfd824, 71f5e6529) shipped changes to internal/cyclestate/read.go (ReadLastCycleNumber 90.9%, ReadState 88.9%) and internal/redteamcheck (NoBatchCycleJump 75.0%) below the 100% that CI's cover-changed gate requires. The build floor only WARNs in shadow (`[build-floor] WARN cover-changed (shadow)`). Every console PR whose diff spans those commits then fails CI on functions it never touched until it is rebased.
title: Cycles ship functions below 100% coverage; the cover-changed check is shadow-only in the loop
